title: Independent audit of matched ligature controls confirms score ties and singleton-rank sensitivity
statement: I independently reran and audited P-L1-007 on the pinned public practice/reference inputs. All recorded results reproduce exactly. Separate counting, Pearson and loss code confirms the numerical scores and the candidate cutoff decisions. Matched wrong-origin symbols can outscore genuine fusions; equal incoming contexts force ties even when outgoing contexts differ. New direct-emission line controls again yield low ligature ranks without performing symbol fusion. The q|i|e cutoff decision depends on an undefined-single-context Pearson convention. These are limitations of the statistical discriminator; they do not adjudicate physical glyph composition or decipherment.
check: Extract the two embedded scripts to one scratch directory and add the repository root to PYTHONPATH. Run original_triplet.py with stdout redirected to replication.json, then run audit_triplet.py to create audit.json. Compare the canonical replication digest and recorded tables. A failure of loss-vector agreement, different cutoff decisions, loss inequality for exact-left-matched candidates, or absence of low ranks in the fixed no-fusion line controls would challenge this audit. The next methodological task is to add a separately specified right-context discriminator and calibrate it on fresh contrasts before using it on manuscript candidates.

methods.reference_conditions: Pinned normalized English, Latin and Italian train/control blocks; up to 40000 characters, trimmed before the last partial word. Contrasts th/to and ea/er; en/es and pa/pe; ch/co and de/di. Candidate labels X,Z denote equal numbers of separated replacements. Planting fractions 1/4, 1/2 and 1 of the matched pool, not of all target occurrences.
methods.loss_conventions: Weights (1,100,1,1,100,1,1,10). Zero an edge below 0.2% of either row or column. Relative glyph support >500/229431. Percentile includes ties over non-space eligible ordered triplets with candidate distinct from components. Literal mode uses matched mass for Rule 3 and (1-min(pA,pB))/max(p) for Rule 6; prose mode uses unmatched mass and 1-min(pA,pB)/max(p). These remain alternative readings of printed equations versus stated rules, not a claim to have recovered the original authors' software.
methods.independent_implementation: Counts windows in a separate loop; uses integer incoming counts and Pearson raw sums, rather than the inherited centred probability vectors. Independently checks source offsets, word-boundary and previous-glyph signature equality. The inherited matcher and encoder are reused, so these are numerical and sampling-invariant checks rather than a completely separate planting implementation.
methods.rank_ties: Independent ranks count all losses <= the candidate loss or numerically equal with rel_tol=abs_tol=1e-12. Loss-vector agreement is checked at rel_tol=abs_tol=1e-11. All tracked 5% decisions agree.
methods.independent_chain: Fit one character-transition count table per edition on public practice training paragraph lines. Sample initial glyphs from training starts; follow the table using sorted cumulative integer draws. At the last position disallow a space. Use public evaluation line lengths, join lines by one space, and never fuse glyphs. This boundary handling means stationarity applies to the shared internal table, not to initial/final positions.

findings: The complete result object from the recorded P-L1-007 script reproduced exactly, including all 72 planting conditions, three adjacency-preserving surrogates, public ZL/Takahashi partitions and twelve inherited line-chain controls. This replicates that implementation, not the authors' unpublished executable or their full-manuscript numerical results.

With word-boundary positions and candidate counts matched, full-pool replacement supports eight of twelve language/partition/contrast comparisons. The wrong-origin candidate has a lower loss in six and the genuine candidate in two, in both literal and prose modes. In four comparisons both candidates rank within 5%. These selected, shared-first-component contrasts do not estimate a population false-positive rate.

With exact previous glyph also matched, all 36 inherited planting conditions have identical X/Z scores despite different outgoing counts; thirteen meet support when counting all three replacement fractions. The tie follows from equal candidate frequency, equal incoming counts, and zero self-adjacency while proposed components A,B are held fixed. No term uses the right-context distribution of the candidate itself.

Separately written counting and loss code agrees with the inherited eight-rule vectors over 556316 triplet-by-convention evaluations in 32 text/convention conditions; the largest rule discrepancy is 3.3306690738754696e-16. All 176 tracked candidate rank decisions at the 5% threshold agree when the independent ranker includes floating-point ties.

At full matched-pool coverage, four additional fixed pairing seeds each reproduce six decoy wins and two genuine wins among eight supported word-position comparisons. Exact-left matching gives seven supported ties per seed. Across all five seed settings, all sixty exact-left trials have different outgoing counts and equal loss for X and Z. Seed settings were fixed in the audit script before running them; none was selected for its outcome.

A separately implemented first-order glyph line chain fitted only on public practice training lines, with six new seeds per edition, places m|i|d in the best 5% in all twelve emitted texts under both conventions. q|i|e passes in two of six ZL-trained and four of six Takahashi-trained texts. This generator emits one glyph at a time from a single transition table and never performs pair fusion. This is a public specificity control, not a new hidden-page generator submission.

For public evaluation q|i|e, the rarer member has one retained incoming context in each edition. Changing only the undefined-single-context Pearson loss from zero to one changes prose-mode rank from 0.04411764705882353 to 0.09627757352941177 in ZL and from 0.04388786764705882 to 0.09857536764705882 in Takahashi. The cutoff decision reverses. The zero-variance case with at least two contexts retains the inherited convention.
limitations: Public practice and reference partitions only; no hidden-page evaluation or scan adjudication was performed.
The full-support comparisons are a selected subset of twelve conditions. Planting seeds are not independent language samples and do not justify a significance estimate.
The 5% rank threshold is a ranking convention over candidate triplets, not a calibrated statistical p-value.
The fixed candidate triplets are investigated examples, not a search over all possible writing systems. Their low rank without fusion does not establish that manuscript glyphs are indivisible.
Printed/stated-rule differences and undefined Pearson cases prevent calling this an exact numerical reproduction of the original paper.

reproduction.instructions: Save the embedded scripts under their dictionary keys in one scratch directory. With the repository as cwd and on PYTHONPATH, run python original_triplet.py > replication.json, then python audit_triplet.py. Standard library only; all manuscript calls explicitly use split_pages("practice", edition).

scripts.audit_triplet.py:
"""Independent numerical audit of P-L1-007 on public practice/reference text.

The inherited script supplies the deterministic planting and line-chain generation.
This module recomputes the loss and rank from separately counted text windows.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import random
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from itertools import product
from pathlib import Path

import original_triplet as original
from vs import corpus, refcorpus

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WEIGHTS = (1, 100, 1, 1, 100, 1, 1, 10)


class AuditScore:
    def __init__(self, text, single_loss=0):
        self.n = len(text)
        self.count = Counter()
        self.edges = Counter()
        self.row, self.col = Counter(), Counter()
        for i, ch in enumerate(text):
            self.count[ch] += 1
            if i:
                previous = text[i - 1]
                self.edges[previous, ch] += 1
                self.row[previous] += 1
                self.col[ch] += 1
        self.symbols = sorted(self.count)
        self.kept = {edge: n for edge, n in self.edges.items()
                     if n * 500 >= max(self.row[edge[0]], self.col[edge[1]])}
        self.p = {ch: n / self.n for ch, n in self.count.items()}
        self.max_p = max(self.count.values()) / self.n
        self.max_edge = max(self.kept.values()) / (self.n - 1)
        diagonal = [n / (self.n - 1) for (a, b), n in self.kept.items() if a == b]
        self.max_diagonal = max(diagonal) if diagonal else 1
        self.eligible = [ch for ch in self.symbols
                         if ch != ' ' and self.count[ch] * 229431 > 500 * self.n]
        self.single_loss = single_loss
        self.left = {}
        for c, a in product(self.symbols, repeat=2):
            rare, frequent = (c, a) if self.count[c] <= self.count[a] else (a, c)
            contexts = [s for s in self.symbols if (s, rare) in self.kept]
            u = [self.kept[s, rare] for s in contexts]
            v = [self.kept.get((s, frequent), 0) for s in contexts]
            if len(contexts) < 2:
                correlation_loss = single_loss if contexts else 0
            else:
                # Pearson via raw sums rather than the inherited centred vectors.
                n = len(u)
                covariance = n * sum(x * y for x, y in zip(u, v)) - sum(u) * sum(v)
                variance_u = n * sum(x * x for x in u) - sum(u) ** 2
                variance_v = n * sum(y * y for y in v) - sum(v) ** 2
                denominator = math.sqrt(variance_u * variance_v)
                correlation_loss = 1 - min(1, abs(covariance / denominator)) if denominator else 1
            common = sum(x for x, y in zip(u, v) if y) / (self.n - 1)
            uncommon = sum(x for x, y in zip(u, v) if not y) / (self.n - 1)
            self.left[c, a] = common, uncommon, correlation_loss

    def losses(self, c, a, b, version):
        pc, pa, pb = self.p[c], self.p[a], self.p[b]
        common, uncommon, pearson = self.left[c, a]
        probability = lambda edge: self.kept.get(edge, 0) / (self.n - 1)
        return (
            max(pc - max(pa, pb), 0) / self.max_p,
            probability((a, b)) / self.max_edge,
            common if version == 'literal' else uncommon,
            pearson,
            probability((c, c)) / self.max_diagonal,
            (1 - min(pa, pb)) / self.max_p if version == 'literal' else 1 - min(pa, pb) / self.max_p,
            pc / ((pa + pc) * (pb + pc)),
            int(a == b),
        )

    def total(self, triplet, version):
        return sum(w * loss for w, loss in zip(WEIGHTS, self.losses(*triplet, version)))


def verify_text(text, label, single_loss=0, tracked=()):
    audit = AuditScore(text, single_loss)
    inherited = original.Score(text, single_context_loss=single_loss)
    assert audit.eligible == inherited.alphabet
    errors = []
    for version in ('literal', 'prose'):
        checked = 0
        max_error = 0
        universe_losses = []
        for t in product(audit.eligible, repeat=3):
            if t[0] in t[1:]:
                continue
            checked += 1
            av, bv = audit.losses(*t, version), inherited.losses(*t, version)
            error = max(abs(x - y) for x, y in zip(av, bv))
            max_error = max(max_error, error)
            assert all(math.isclose(x, y, rel_tol=1e-11, abs_tol=1e-11) for x, y in zip(av, bv)), (label, t, av, bv)
            universe_losses.append(sum(w * x for w, x in zip(WEIGHTS, av)))
        ranks = {}
        inherited_rank = inherited.ranker(version)
        for t in tracked:
            if not all(ch in audit.count for ch in t):
                continue
            score = audit.total(t, version)
            # Include numerical ties, rather than breaking them by floating point round-off.
            rank = sum(x <= score or math.isclose(x, score, rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-12)
                       for x in universe_losses) / len(universe_losses)
            previous = inherited_rank(t)
            ranks['|'.join(t)] = {'audit_rank_with_ties': rank, 'recorded_rank': previous['rank'],
                                  'same_5pct_decision': (rank <= .05) == (previous['rank'] <= .05)}
            assert ranks['|'.join(t)]['same_5pct_decision'], (label, t, ranks['|'.join(t)])
        errors.append({'version': version, 'triplets': checked, 'max_rule_absolute_error': max_error, 'tracked_ranks': ranks})
    return {'label': label, 'characters': len(text), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(), 'audit': errors}


def main():
    output = {'audited_texts': [], 'matching_checks': [], 'seed_sensitivity': []}
    # Original contrast seeds, plus four fixed new seeds, chosen before this run.
    seeds = [9141, 137, 271, 409, 593]
    for language, contrasts in original.CONTRASTS.items():
        for partition, loader in [('train', refcorpus.train_text), ('control', refcorpus.control_text)]:
            text = ' ' + ' '.join(loader(language))[:40000].rsplit(' ', 1)[0] + ' '
            for index, (target, decoy) in enumerate(contrasts):
                for by_left in (False, True):
                    for seed in seeds:
                        actual_seed = seed + index if seed == 9141 else seed
                        pool = original.paired_positions(text, target, decoy, by_left, actual_seed)
                        encoded = original.encode(text, pool)
                        # Verify planting directly from source offsets, independently of the grouping code.
                        signature_x, signature_z = Counter(), Counter()
                        for i, j in pool:
                            assert text[i:i+2] == target and text[j:j+2] == decoy
                            signature = lambda k: (text[k-1] == ' ', text[k+2] == ' ', text[k-1] if by_left else '')
                            signature_x[signature(i)] += 1
                            signature_z[signature(j)] += 1
                        assert signature_x == signature_z
                        audit = AuditScore(encoded)
                        assert audit.count['X'] == audit.count['Z'] == len(pool)
                        incoming = sum(abs(audit.edges[s, 'X'] - audit.edges[s, 'Z']) for s in audit.symbols)
                        outgoing = sum(abs(audit.edges['X', s] - audit.edges['Z', s]) for s in audit.symbols)
                        eligible = 'X' in audit.eligible and 'Z' in audit.eligible
                        row = {'language': language, 'partition': partition, 'target': target, 'decoy': decoy,
                               'left_matched': by_left, 'seed': actual_seed, 'pairs': len(pool),
                               'eligible': eligible, 'incoming_L1': incoming, 'outgoing_L1': outgoing, 'scores': {}}
                        for version in ('literal', 'prose'):
                            x, z = audit.total(('X', *target), version), audit.total(('Z', *target), version)
                            row['scores'][version] = {'X': x, 'Z': z, 'difference_X_minus_Z': x-z}
                            if by_left:
                                assert incoming == 0 and math.isclose(x, z, abs_tol=1e-12)
                        output['seed_sensitivity'].append(row)
                        if seed == 9141:
                            label = f'{language}/{partition}/{target}-{decoy}/left={by_left}'
                            output['audited_texts'].append(verify_text(encoded, label, tracked=[('X', *target), ('Z', *target)]))
    for edition in ('zl', 'it'):
        for partition, pages in zip(('train', 'evaluation'), corpus.split_pages('practice', edition)):
            text = ' '.join(w for p in pages for ln in p.lines if ln.unit == 'P'
                            for w in ln.words if w.isascii() and w.isalpha())
            for single_loss in (0, 1):
                output['audited_texts'].append(verify_text(text, f'{edition}/{partition}/singleton={single_loss}', single_loss, original.DRAFT_TRIPLETS))
    output['independent_line_chain'] = independent_line_chain()
    (ROOT / 'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'audited_texts': len(output['audited_texts']), 'seed_conditions': len(output['seed_sensitivity'])}))


def independent_line_chain():
    """Fit a first-order table separately and emit glyphs without any pair fusion."""
    results = []
    for edition in ('zl', 'it'):
        training, evaluation = corpus.split_pages('practice', edition)
        clean = lambda pages: [' '.join(w for w in ln.words if w.isascii() and w.isalpha())
                               for p in pages for ln in p.lines if ln.unit == 'P']
        train = [ln for ln in clean(training) if ln]
        lengths = [len(ln) for ln in clean(evaluation) if ln]
        starts, transitions = Counter(ln[0] for ln in train), defaultdict(Counter)
        for line in train:
            for i in range(1, len(line)):
                transitions[line[i-1]][line[i]] += 1
        for seed in range(18710, 18716):
            rng = random.Random(seed)
            def draw(counts):
                # Sorted, cumulative integer sampling differs from the inherited expanded-list sampler.
                threshold = rng.randrange(sum(counts.values()))
                for symbol, count in sorted(counts.items()):
                    if threshold < count:
                        return symbol
                    threshold -= count
                raise AssertionError('invalid transition draw')
            lines = []
            for length in lengths:
                sequence = [draw(starts)]
                while len(sequence) < length:
                    options = transitions[sequence[-1]]
                    if len(sequence) == length - 1:
                        options = Counter({s: n for s, n in options.items() if s != ' '})
                    sequence.append(draw(options or starts))
                lines.append(''.join(sequence))
            text = ' '.join(lines)
            assert [len(s) for s in lines] == lengths and '  ' not in text
            calculator = AuditScore(text)
            row = {'edition': edition, 'seed': seed, 'characters': len(text),
                   'sha256': hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(), 'ranks': {}}
            for version in ('literal', 'prose'):
                losses = [calculator.total(t, version) for t in product(calculator.eligible, repeat=3) if t[0] not in t[1:]]
                row['ranks'][version] = {}
                for t in original.DRAFT_TRIPLETS:
                    if not all(ch in calculator.p for ch in t):
                        continue
                    score = calculator.total(t, version)
                    rank = sum(x <= score or math.isclose(x, score, rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-12) for x in losses) / len(losses)
                    row['ranks'][version]['|'.join(t)] = {'rank': rank, 'competing': all(ch in calculator.eligible for ch in t)}
            results.append(row)
    return results


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
